t: An open source nano quadcopter that students program with Python.
steps: Find the Crazyflie pages from Bitcraze and read the setup guide.
Ask IT to help install the Crazyflie client or the Python library.
Buy the drone and a Crazyradio dongle.
Buy prop guards and spare batteries.
Update the firmware and fly a first test.
Plan around about 60 minutes of charging per battery.
